tei:div.tei:p: "$ (115)༄༅// bo dong lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po zab gsal gyi ring brgyud gsol 'debs ye shes mchog stsol ces bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo gu ru bhyaḥ /dpal ldan mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba che// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan shes rab yum// zung 'jug 'jam pa'i rdo rje e waṃ sbyor// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// re sa gzhan na med do 'gro ba'i mgon// tshad med thugs rje'i spyan gyis legs gzigs nas// log pa'i lam du nam yang mi ltung zhing*// yang dag lam gyi ded dpon mdzad du gsol// rgyal ba mchog gis dngos su rjes bzung ste// dbang bskur lung sbyin lung bstan thob pa las// dngos grub mchog brnyes sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud sogs tshig rkang pa lnga po rgyas par thams cad kyi mjug tu sbyar// bsdu na snga ma rnams la/ gsol ba 'debs so sogs tshig rkang gcig kho na dang*/ rdzogs mtshams su lnga ka sbyar ro/ /mi shes mun pa'i tshogs 'joms mar me mdzad// nyams dang rtogs pa'i dpal mnga' bde ba che// mchog gi lam ston dri med sbas pa'i zhabs// gsol ba= /mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba kun ston pa liṃ pa// rkang gnyis dbang phyug gnyosa~X ston lo~X tsa~X' ba~X// byanga~X chuba~X thugs gnyis legs par 'byongs pa'i dpala~X// gsol ba= /rtsa rlung sems la dbang thob grags pa dpal// mtha' bral don gzigs gnyosa~X stona~X gzi~X brjida~X dpa~Xl// rgyal ba'i sras po skyes mchog ye shes mkhar// gsol ba= /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan kun mkhyen pa/ chos sku 'od zer/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa kun mkhyen 'od// mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rin chen grub/ bu ston/ /gsol ba= /byang chub rtse mor son pa'i lo chen byang chub rtse mo pa// lung rig smra ba'i dbang phyug grags lo chen pa'i zhabs// khams (116)gsum 'dren zla bral ba 'chi med sde/ bo dong paṇa chen/ /gsol ba= /'ja' lus dwangs ma'i sku brnyes bsod nams mchog shangs ras chen/ /dus gsum rnam mkhyen byams pa chos kyi nyid// zung 'jug grub pa padma gar dbang la// gsol ba=

/mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug grags pa 'od zer dang*// snang sems dbyer med gar dbang bstan 'dzin dpal// mos gus phyag chen mthar phyin ratna'i mtshan// gsol ba= /zab gsal chos kyi rgya mtsho 'dus chen pa// bsam bzhin sprul pa'i skur snang rnam pa gnyis// brtul zhugs grub pa nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la// gsol ba= /mkhas shing grub brnyes 'jam dbyangs rnam par rgyal// rig 'dzin grub pa'i gtsug rgyan rnam rgyal sde// chos dbyings mngon gyur bde chen mtsho mo la// gsol ba= /zab mo stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang*// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug pa'i// nges don lam ston rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /yang na 'chi med sde'i rjes su/ /kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i dpal// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos 'chi med dpal bzang po// zung 'jug grub pa padma gar dbang la// gsol ba= /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug sogs man 'dra'o// bdag sogs deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// dal 'byor lus thob bstan la rab byung nas// yang dag bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung ste// zab gsal gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog /'khrul snang sgyu ma'i mdzes mas mi bslu zhing*// stobs ldan gdod ma'i rdo rjes mi skrag par// sbyang bya sbyong byed rnal 'byor zab mo yis// sbyang gzhi dri med sbyangs 'bras mngon gyur shog /dam pa'i don du yod dang med pa dang*// yin dang ma yin gnyis ka gnyis min sogs// mthar 'dzin lta ba mtha' dag drung phyung ste// mi rtog ye shes rang zhal mthong bar shog /chos kun ngo bo ngos bzung kun bral (117)yang*// rnam 'gyur sna tshogs gsal bar snang ba'i gnad// legs par rtogs nas sgro skur kun spangs te// zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog thob shog /gnas skabs su yang dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa'i// 'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs kun thag bsrings te// mthun pa'i rkyen rnams mtha' dag lhun grub nas// dge legs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar shog
/ces grub chen sangs rgyas ye shes zhal nas brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po zab gsal gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs zhal skong dang bcas pa dge// (118)
